newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market easier in subdued trade.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market easier in subdued trade.

text.p: Brokers reported little buying interest and few firm trades in the Bradford wool market on Monday.
Most prices were steady to easier with English all down six pence per kg.
Market sources attributed the lack of activity to the schedule of large offerings in key overseas markets beginning this week and set to keep prices low in buyers favour.
Limited buying from Italy in the market for finer tops is subduing hopes of a merino-led recovery, they said.
Some topmakers still expect improved demand demand between November and the end of the year but others are less bullish, noting poor business confidence in the UK retail market for woollen products.
